# pve_vm (Resource)

Manages one QEMU guest (KVM virtual machine) on a PVE node (`POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /nodes/{node}/qemu/{vmid}`). Changing `node` performs a live migration instead of recreation. Config keys outside this schema are part of the guest, but this resource never sends or deletes them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# A minimal QEMU guest on node pve1. The provider allocates the next free
# VMID at create time because `vmid` is omitted.
resource "pve_vm" "web" {
  node     = "pve1"
  name     = "web01"
  ostype   = "l26"
  cores    = 2
  sockets  = 1
  memory   = 2048
  cpu_type = "host"
  scsihw   = "virtio-scsi-single"
  onboot   = true
  tags     = ["prod", "web"]

  disks = [
    {
      id       = "scsi0"
      storage  = "local-lvm"
      size     = "32G"
      iothread = true
      discard  = "on"
      ssd      = true
    },
  ]

  network_interfaces = [
    {
      id       = "net0"
      model    = "virtio"
      bridge   = "vmbr0"
      vlan_tag = 10
      firewall = true
    },
  ]

  cloud_init = {
    user         = "admin"
    searchdomain = "example.internal"
    nameserver   = "10.0.0.1"
    # Read from a public key file on the machine running Terraform:
    # sshkeys = file("/home/user/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
    sshkeys = "ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIExamplePublicKeyPlaceholder"

    ipconfig = {
      ipconfig0 = "ip=dhcp"
    }
  }
}

# A guest created by cloning a template on the same node.
resource "pve_vm" "cloned" {
  node    = "pve1"
  vmid    = 105
  cores   = 4
  memory  = 4096
  started = true

  clone = {
    source_vmid = 9000
    full        = true
    storage     = "local-lvm"
    format      = "qcow2"
    name        = "clone01"
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name the guest runs on. Changing the node migrates the guest (`POST .../migrate` + task wait) instead of recreating it.

### Optional

- `agent` (Boolean) Enable/disable communication with the QEMU Guest Agent (pin `agent`, rendered as `enabled=<1|0>`; default 0).
- `bios` (String) Select BIOS implementation. Must be one of: `seabios`, `ovmf`.
- `boot_order` (List of String) Guest boot order as an ordered device list (pin `boot`, rendered as `order=<dev>;<dev>`), e.g. `["scsi0", "net0"]`.
- `clone` (Attributes) Create the guest by cloning an existing VM or template instead of fresh creation (`POST .../clone`). Create-only: the block cannot be added or changed after creation. All non-clone attributes are applied to the clone via a config PUT after the clone task finishes; the `disks` list is ignored in clone mode because the clone copies the source disks. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--clone))
- `cloud_init` (Attributes) Cloud-init parameters rendered to the pin's `ciuser`/`cipassword`/`searchdomain`/`nameserver`/`sshkeys`/`ipconfig[n]` config keys. Requires a cloud-init enabled image. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--cloud_init))
- `cores` (Number) The number of cores per socket (pin `cores`, default 1). Must be at least 1.
- `cpu_type` (String) Emulated CPU type (pin `cpu` parameter, rendered as `cputype=<value>`), e.g. `kvm64`, `x86-64-v2-AES`, `host`, or a custom model.
- `description` (String) Description for the VM, shown in the web interface summary (pin `description`).
- `disks` (Attributes List) Ordered virtual disk drives (pin `ide[n]`/`sata[n]`/`scsi[n]`/`virtio[n]`/`efidisk0`). New drives allocate `storage:size` volumes; size changes only grow (`PUT .../resize`); storage moves issue `POST .../move_disk`; removals delete the config entry (the volume becomes an `unusedN` disk). Sizes are allocated in whole GiB. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--disks))
- `machine` (String) Specify the QEMU machine (pin `machine`), e.g. `q35`, `pc`, or a versioned type like `pc-q35-9.0`.
- `memory` (Number) Amount of online RAM for the VM in MiB (pin `memory` `current`, default 512). Must be at least 16.
- `migrate_with_local_disks` (Boolean) Enable live storage migration for local disks when the guest is migrated to another node (pin `with-local-disks`).
- `name` (String) Set a name for the VM (pin `name`, DNS-name format; only used on the web interface).
- `network_interfaces` (Attributes List) Ordered network devices (pin `net[n]`). Removals delete the config entry; changes re-render the device value. A null `macaddr` lets PVE generate one at create. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--network_interfaces))
- `onboot` (Boolean) Specifies whether the VM will be started during system bootup (pin `onboot`, default 0).
- `ostype` (String) Specify guest operating system. Must be one of: `other`, `wxp`, `w2k`, `w2k3`, `w2k8`, `wvista`, `win7`, `win8`, `win10`, `win11`, `l24`, `l26`, `solaris`.
- `protection` (Boolean) Sets the protection flag of the VM, disabling remove-VM and remove-disk operations (pin `protection`, default 0).
- `scsihw` (String) SCSI controller model. Must be one of: `lsi`, `lsi53c810`, `virtio-scsi-pci`, `virtio-scsi-single`, `megasas`, `pvscsi`.
- `sockets` (Number) The number of CPU sockets (pin `sockets`, default 1). Must be at least 1.
- `started` (Boolean) Whether the guest should be running. Create waits for the start task when true; updates issue start/shutdown tasks on change. Templates never start. Reflects the live power state on read.
- `stop_on_destroy` (Boolean) When true, destroy issues an ACPI shutdown (then a hard stop if still running) before deleting the guest. When false the destroy call itself stops a running guest's process.
- `tags` (List of String) Tags of the VM (pin `tags`, a `;`-separated tag list rendered from this ordered list). This is only meta information.
- `target_storage` (String) Migration target storage mapping (pin `targetstorage`): a single storage ID maps all source storages to it; the special value `1` maps each source storage to itself.
- `template` (Boolean) Whether the guest is a template. Template conversion is create-only per the pin; changing this value forces replacement.
- `vmid` (Number) The (unique) VM ID. Pin range 100-999999999. When null at create, the next free ID is allocated via `GET /cluster/nextid` and stored. Changing the VM ID forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in `<node>/<vmid>` form.
- `maxcpu` (Number) Maximum usable CPUs (pin status field `cpus`).
- `maxmem` (Number) Maximum memory in bytes, from the status read.
- `pending_changes` (List of String) Config keys with staged (not yet applied) changes or pending deletes from `GET .../pending`. Pending values are merged into this resource's computed view so drift surfaces before the next apply.
- `status` (String) QEMU process status, `running` or `stopped`.
- `uptime` (Number) Uptime of the guest in seconds (0 when stopped).

<a id="nestedatt--clone"></a>
### Nested Schema for `clone`

Required:

- `source_vmid` (Number) VMID of the source VM or template to clone (pin `vmid` of the clone endpoint).

Optional:

- `format` (String) Target disk format for a full clone. Must be one of: `raw`, `qcow2`, `vmdk`.
- `full` (Boolean) Create a full copy of all disks (pin `full`). PVE defaults to linked clones for templates when false; disk format below only applies to full clones.
- `name` (String) Set a name for the new VM (pin clone `name`).
- `pool` (String) Add the new VM to the specified pool (pin clone `pool`).
- `storage` (String) Target storage for a full clone (pin clone `storage`).


<a id="nestedatt--cloud_init"></a>
### Nested Schema for `cloud_init`

Optional:

- `ipconfig` (Map of String) IP configurations keyed by interface (`ipconfig0`-`ipconfig31`), e.g. `ipconfig0 = "ip=10.0.0.5/24,gw=10.0.0.1"`. Use `dhcp` for DHCP.
- `nameserver` (String) Cloud-init DNS server IP address.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Cloud-init password (pin `cipassword`). Write-only: PVE never returns it, so it is applied when set and never removed.
- `searchdomain` (String) Cloud-init DNS search domains.
- `sshkeys` (String) Public SSH keys, one per line (OpenSSH format). Percent-encoded on the wire per the pin's `urlencoded` format.
- `user` (String) Cloud-init user name to change ssh keys and password for instead of the image's default user (pin `ciuser`).


<a id="nestedatt--disks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `disks`

Required:

- `id` (String) Drive key, one of `ide0`-`ide3`, `sata0`-`sata5`, `scsi0`-`scsi30`, `virtio0`-`virtio15`, or `efidisk0`.

Optional:

- `cache` (String) The drive's cache mode. Must be one of: `none`, `writethrough`, `writeback`, `unsafe`, `directsync`.
- `discard` (String) Whether discard/trim requests pass to the underlying storage. Must be one of: `ignore`, `on`.
- `format` (String) The drive's backing file data format. Must be one of: `raw`, `qcow`, `qed`, `qcow2`, `vmdk`, `cloop`.
- `iothread` (Boolean) Whether to use iothreads for this drive.
- `size` (String) Drive size in PVE disk-size syntax (e.g. `32G`, `512M`). Growth-only: shrinking issues an error. New volumes are allocated in whole GiB.
- `ssd` (Boolean) Whether to expose this drive as an SSD (only supported on SCSI and SATA drives).
- `storage` (String) Storage ID backing the drive. Required when the drive allocates a new volume.


<a id="nestedatt--network_interfaces"></a>
### Nested Schema for `network_interfaces`

Required:

- `id` (String) Device key `net0`-`net31`.
- `model` (String) Network card model. Must be one of: `e1000`, `e1000-82540em`, `e1000-82544gc`, `e1000-82545em`, `e1000e`, `i82551`, `i82557b`, `i82559er`, `ne2k_isa`, `ne2k_pci`, `pcnet`, `rtl8139`, `virtio`, `vmxnet3`.

Optional:

- `bridge` (String) Bridge to attach the device to (e.g. `vmbr0`). Omitting it creates a NATed user-mode network device.
- `firewall` (Boolean) Whether this interface should be protected by the firewall.
- `macaddr` (String) MAC address (pin `macaddr`), auto-generated by PVE when unset. Must be unique within the network.
- `queues` (Number) Number of packet queues used on the device. Must be between 0 and 64.
- `vlan_tag` (Number) VLAN tag to apply to packets on this interface (pin `tag`). Must be between 1 and 4094.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Copyright (c) HashiCorp, Inc.

# The import ID is <node>/<vmid>.
terraform import pve_vm.web pve1/100
```
